import re, os, sys

ROOT='/app/dclm'
pats = [
 ('AKIA',        r'AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}'),
 ('ghp',         r'ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}'),
 ('gh[ousr]',    r'gh[ousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}'),
 ('github_pat',  r'github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}'),
 ('hf',          r'hf_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}'),
 ('xox',         r'xox[baprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}'),
 ('aws_secret_c',r'(?i)(aws_?secret_?(access_?)?key|secret_access_key)\s*[:=]\s*[\'"]?[A-Za-z0-9/+=]{16,}'),
 ('awsid_c',     r'(?i)aws_?access_?key_?id\s*[:=]\s*[\'"]?[A-Z0-9]{16,}'),
 ('apikey_c',    r'(?i)(api[_-]?key)\s*[:=]\s*[\'"]?[A-Za-z0-9+/_\-\.]{12,}'),
 ('token_c',     r'(?i)(\btoken|auth_token|access_token|hf_token|GH_TOKEN|GIT_TOKEN)\s*[:=]\s*[\'"]?[A-Za-z0-9+/_\-\.]{12,}'),
 ('password_c',  r'(?i)(password|passwd|passw)\s*[:=]\s*[\'"]?[A-Za-z0-9+/_\-\.]{8,}'),
 ('secret_c',    r'(?i)\bsecret\b\s*[:=]\s*[\'"]?[A-Za-z0-9+/_\-\.]{16,}'),
 ('bearer',      r'Bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9+/_\-\.]{16,}'),
 ('basic_auth',  r'Basic\s+[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{16,}'),
 ('url_creds',   r'://[A-Za-z0-9._-]+:[A-Za-z0-9+/_\-\.]{12,}@'),
]
comps = [(n, re.compile(p)) for n,p in pats]

for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(ROOT):
    if '.git' in dirpath.split(os.sep): 
        dirnames[:] = [d for d in dirnames if d != '.git']
        continue
    for fn in sorted(filenames):
        p = os.path.join(dirpath, fn)
        try:
            raw = open(p, encoding='utf-8', errors='strict').read()
        except Exception:
            # binary
            raw = open(p, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace').read()
        rel = os.path.relpath(p, ROOT)
        for name, c in comps:
            for m in c.finditer(raw):
                val = m.group(0)
                # mask: keep first 5 and last 4
                mk = val[:5] + '...'+val[-4:] if len(val) > 14 else val
                line = raw[:m.start()].count('\n') + 1
                print(f"FILE {rel} | {name} | line {line} | {mk} (len {len(val)})")
EOF

import re, os, json

ROOT = '/app/dclm'
P_AWS_ID   = '<your-aws-access-key-id>'
P_AWS_SEC  = '<your-aws-secret-access-key>'
P_GH       = '<your-github-token>'
P_HF       = '<your-huggingface-token>'

# (compiled pattern, replacement callable) -- applied in order
SUBS = [
    # AWS access key id (AKIA + 16..40 uppercase alnum)
    (re.compile(r'AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16,40}'), lambda m: P_AWS_ID),
    # GitHub tokens
    (re.compile(r'ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}'),  lambda m: P_GH),
    (re.compile(r'gh[ousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}'), lambda m: P_GH),
    (re.compile(r'github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{30,}'), lambda m: P_GH),
    # HuggingFace tokens
    (re.compile(r'hf_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}'), lambda m: P_HF),
    # AWS secret access key value in an assignment context
    (re.compile(r"(?i)(AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY(?:['\"]\])?\s*=\s*['\"]?)([A-Za-z0-9/+=]{30,80})"),
     lambda m: m.group(1) + P_AWS_SEC),
]

# 1) collect all secret values present, across the whole tree, BEFORE replacing
secrets = set()
all_files = []
for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(ROOT):
    dirnames[:] = [d for d in dirnames if d != '.git']
    for fn in sorted(filenames):
        all_files.append(os.path.join(dirpath, fn))

for p in all_files:
    try:
        t = open(p, encoding='utf-8', errors='strict').read()
    except Exception:
        continue
    for m in re.finditer(r'AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16,40}', t): secrets.add(m.group(0))
    for m in re.finditer(r'gh[psousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}', t): secrets.add(m.group(0))
    for m in re.finditer(r'github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{30,}', t): secrets.add(m.group(0))
    for m in re.finditer(r'hf_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}', t): secrets.add(m.group(0))
    for m in re.finditer(r"(?i)AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY(?:['\"]\])?\s*=\s*['\"]?([A-Za-z0-9/+=]{30,80})", t): secrets.add(m.group(1))

print(f"collected {len(secrets)} distinct secret values; lengths: {sorted(len(s) for s in secrets)}")

# 2) apply replacements; write only changed files
changed = {}
for p in all_files:
    try:
        t = open(p, encoding='utf-8', errors='strict').read()
    except Exception:
        continue
    orig = t
    n_total = 0
    for rx, rep in SUBS:
        t, n = rx.subn(rep, t)
        n_total += n
    if t != orig:
        with open(p, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as f:
            f.write(t)
        changed[os.path.relpath(p, ROOT)] = n_total

print("changed files:")
for k, v in sorted(changed.items()):
    print(f"  {k}: {v} replacements")

# 3) VERIFY
ok = True
def check(name, cond):
    global ok
    print(("PASS " if cond else "FAIL ") + name)
    if not cond: ok = False

# 3a) no secret value remains anywhere in working tree
bad = []
for p in all_files:
    try:
